page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, utilizing dedicated CPU allocation with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is a weak point, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% categories, respectively. Single-threaded gzip compression also registers in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is more resilient, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores all ranking in the middle 50% average range. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, as well as Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, consistently perform within average parameters.

The instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding top-tier single-threaded CPU performance. The primary tradeoff is the lower single-core execution speed, which limits its suitability for latency-sensitive or single-threaded tasks. However, the 128.0 GB memory capacity and average multi-core capabilities make this instance suitable for database operations, caching layers like Redis, and memory-intensive web serving or moderate multi-threaded data processing.
